post.caption:
Humans are the only naked primate, and the leading explanation is cooling. A furred animal sheds heat by panting, which works properly only once it stops running. Bare skin plus about two million sweat glands lets you cool while still moving. That made persistence hunting possible: an antelope beats you over a kilometre and overheats over thirty. We are mediocre at strength, speed and climbing, and outstanding at not stopping.
